name.zh: 安大略省横加公路 17 号

tagline.en: The longest provincial share, and the gap that closed two years before the rest
tagline.zh: 各省之中最长的一段；其缺口的闭合，比全线早了两年

start.en: The Manitoba boundary west of Kenora, where Manitoba's PTH 1 becomes Ontario's Highway 17
start.zh: 肯诺拉以西的马尼托巴省界，马尼托巴 PTH 1 在此变为安大略 17 号公路

end.en: Arnprior, west of Ottawa, where the Trans-Canada designation continues on Highway 417
end.zh: 渥太华以西的阿恩普赖尔，横加公路的指定在此转由 417 号公路承接

en: Ontario carries more of the Trans-Canada Highway than any other province — 1,453 miles of it when the federal government last published a provincial breakdown — and Highway 17 is the main line. It runs from the Manitoba border to Arnprior, and for most of that it is the only paved road across the top of Lake Superior and the only land connection between eastern and western Canada.

That is a sentence worth pausing on. Everything moving by truck between Toronto and Winnipeg either goes along this two-lane road around Lake Superior or leaves the country and takes the American Interstates south of the lakes. When Highway 17 closes for a collision at Wawa, there is no detour.

Ontario signs the designation differently from the west. The number belongs to the King's Highway system and is posted on the black-and-white crown shield; the Trans-Canada is a separate green-and-white sign carrying no number at all, mounted beside it. The province also names its branches rather than numbering them — the Northern Ontario Route on Highway 11, the Central Ontario and Georgian Bay Route on 7, 12, 400 and 69 — so eleven different King's Highways carry a piece of the designation.
zh: 安大略承担的横加公路里程超过任何其他省份——联邦政府最后一次公布分省数据时为 1,453 英里——而 17 号公路是其主线。它自马尼托巴省界通到阿恩普赖尔，其中大部分路段是苏必利尔湖以北唯一的铺装道路，也是加拿大东西两半之间唯一的陆上通道。
这句话值得停下来想一想。多伦多与温尼伯之间所有的卡车运输，要么走这条绕苏必利尔湖的双车道公路，要么出境走五大湖以南的美国州际公路。当 17 号公路因瓦瓦附近的事故封闭时，没有绕行路线。
安大略的标识方式与西部不同。编号属于「国王公路」系统，挂在黑白王冠盾牌上；横加公路则是另一块不带任何编号的绿白标志，并列安装。该省的支线也用名称而非编号称呼——11 号公路上的「北安大略线」，7、12、400、69 号公路上的「中安大略与乔治亚湾线」——因此共有十一条国王公路各承担一段指定路线。

en: Ontario signed on 25 April 1950, the first day agreements were signed. Its problem was the 165 miles between Wawa and Sault Ste. Marie: the Lake Superior shore, where the Canadian Shield comes down to the water and there was no road at all.

Sixty per cent of it had to be built on new location. It took about twenty-five bridges and crossed muskeg up to fifteen metres deep, which has to be excavated or displaced before anything can be founded on it. The section opened in September 1960 — two years before the ceremony at Rogers Pass, and arguably the harder piece of work.

Until that road opened there was no way to drive from one side of Canada to the other without entering the United States. The Rogers Pass opening in 1962 is remembered as the moment the country was joined; the Lake Superior gap is the one that had to close first.
zh: 安大略于 1950 年 4 月 25 日签约，是首批签署协议的省份之一。它的难题是瓦瓦与苏圣玛丽之间的 165 英里：苏必利尔湖岸，加拿大地盾直抵水边，原本没有任何道路。
其中六成必须在全新线位上开辟。工程需要约二十五座桥梁，并穿越深达十五米的泥炭沼泽——这种地层必须先挖除或置换，才能在上面建任何东西。该路段于 1960 年 9 月通车，比罗杰斯山口的仪式早两年，工程难度只怕更大。
在这条路通车之前，人们无法不经过美国而从加拿大的一端开到另一端。1962 年罗杰斯山口的通车被记作全国连成一体的时刻；而苏必利尔湖的这处缺口，是必须先闭合的那一个。

value.en: 1,453 miles (2,338 km) of the main route — the largest provincial share, about 30 per cent of the 4,860-mile total
value.zh: 主线 1,453 英里（2,338 公里），为各省之最，约占全线 4,860 英里的三成

figures.source: Canada Year Book 1967, p. 805, Dominion Bureau of Statistics

value.en: 165 miles (265 km) from Wawa to Sault Ste. Marie, 60 per cent on new location, about 25 bridges, muskeg up to 15 m deep; opened September 1960
value.zh: 自瓦瓦至苏圣玛丽 165 英里（265 公里），六成为全新线位，桥梁约 25 座，泥炭沼泽深达 15 米；1960 年 9 月通车

label.en: Route numbers carrying the designation in Ontario
label.zh: 安大略承载指定路线的公路编号

value.en: Eleven: 17, 11, 417, 7, 12, 400, 69, 71, 66, 17A and 115 — more than any other province

figures.source: Statistics Canada, National Road Network, Trans-Canada Highway layer, queried September 2026

why.en: No public figure. The per-province breakdown of the $825 million in federal payments exists only in the Department of Public Works' 1971 final report, which has not been digitised.
why.zh: 无公开数据。8.25 亿加元联邦拨款的分省明细仅见于公共工程部 1971 年的最终报告，该报告未数字化。

timeline.en: Ontario signs its Trans-Canada Highway agreement with Ottawa on 25 April.
timeline.zh: 4 月 25 日，安大略与渥太华签署横加公路协议。

timeline.en: The 165-mile Lake Superior gap between Wawa and Sault Ste. Marie opens in September, making it possible for the first time to drive across Canada without entering the United States.
timeline.zh: 9 月，瓦瓦至苏圣玛丽之间 165 英里的苏必利尔湖缺口通车，人们首次得以不经美国横穿加拿大。
